meta.name: auto-proxy-detect
meta.description: Diagnose local proxy availability, validate HTTP/HTTPS proxy behavior, probe target resources, and choose the safest network execution path for tools like Codex, OpenCode, docker, npm, pip, apt, curl, and git.

copy.tagline: 自动检测代理可用性并选择安全网络路径
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要配置代理来访问受限资源
copy.tagline_en: Automatically detect proxy availability and choose safe network paths
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to configure proxies to access restricted resources

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在执行需要网络的命令前，自动检测本地代理（如 Clash、V2Ray）是否可用，验证代理能否正常访问 HTTP/HTTPS 目标，并推荐最安全的网络执行方式（直连、临时代理等）。
howto.when: 当你运行 docker pull、npm install、git clone、curl 等需要联网的命令，或怀疑代理、DNS、TLS 有问题时触发。

say.text: 帮我检测一下本地代理是否可用，然后执行 npm install。
say.note: Claude 会先检测代理，再安装依赖。

say.text: 用代理拉取这个 Docker 镜像：nginx:latest。
say.note: Claude 会临时注入代理环境变量来拉取镜像。

say.text: 检查一下能否通过代理访问 https://registry.npmjs.org。
say.note: Claude 会探测目标并报告结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will automatically detect local proxy availability (e.g., Clash, V2Ray), validate HTTP/HTTPS proxy behavior, probe target resources, and recommend the safest network execution path (direct, ephemeral proxy, etc.) before running network-dependent commands.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you run network-dependent commands like docker pull, npm install, git clone, curl, or when you suspect proxy, DNS, TLS, or routing issues.

say_en.text: Check if the local proxy is available, then run npm install.
say_en.note: Claude will detect proxy first, then install dependencies.

say_en.text: Pull this Docker image using proxy: nginx:latest.
say_en.note: Claude will inject proxy env vars temporarily to pull the image.

say_en.text: Probe if https://registry.npmjs.org is reachable via proxy.
say_en.note: Claude will probe the target and report the result.
